errors.evidence: The chart displays nine datasets/metrics, not eight. The datasets are GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (x5), and Chat-Arena-Hard.
The label on the x-axis is "LC AlpacaEval-2", with a hyphen. The description omits the hyphen.
The label on the x-axis is "MT-Bench (x5)", not "(×.5)". The description incorrectly states the multiplier.
The phrase "modest performance improvement" is an interpretation of the data rather than a direct description of what the chart shows.

errors.text_span: On MMLU, the scores are approximately 68% and 70%, respectively.
errors.evidence: The chart shows the scores for MMLU are approximately 66% for LLaMA-3-8B-it (blue) and 65% for Ours (orange). The stated values of 68% and 70% are inaccurate overestimations.

errors.text_span: On MMLU, the scores are approximately 68% and 70%, respectively.
errors.evidence: The description implies that the orange bar (Ours) is taller than the blue bar (LLaMA-3-8B-it) for the MMLU dataset. However, the chart shows the blue bar is slightly taller than the orange bar.

errors.text_span: On MBPP, scores are about 60% and 62%.
errors.evidence: The description implies that the orange bar (Ours) is taller than the blue bar (LLaMA-3-8B-it) for the MBPP dataset. The chart shows the bars are nearly identical in height, with the blue bar being negligibly taller if at all.

In the sentence 'On MT-Bench (×.5), scores are approximately 40% and 45%', the value for the orange bar (Ours) is stated as 45%. The chart shows this value is approximately 42%, making 45% a noticeable overestimation.
